overall_assessment: All 28 packet entries were read in full, including their removal spans; INT1140 contains a packet truncation marker. All 12 name_like flags are false alarms caused by legitimate subject-matter names, place and organisation names, course titles, or capitalised English phrases; no private-person names, contact details, or contact blocks were found. Anonymization generally preserves the content, but one suspect loses a historical year range and one random control retains a course-title revision date; the other 15 random controls show no confirmed anonymization defect.

findings.evidence: … landene, ikke minst i etterkant av [−2007-08.−] finanskrisen. I introduksjonsfaget i internasjonal historie …
findings.description: The historical dating of the financial crisis, 2007-08, is removed. This is a content year range that the rubric requires keeping, rather than an academic year. The name_like flag is unrelated and is a false alarm; this content loss was found by reviewing the removed spans.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/anonymize.R: .anon_generic() applies .drop_academic_year() to consecutive year ranges from 1990 onward. The .running_text_year guard and .year_cue allow removal after the preposition i and at a sentence ending, so finanskrisen i 2007-08 is misclassified as administrative dating.
findings.suggested_fix: Require an explicit academic-year, semester, cohort, or administrative cue before removing a consecutive year range from running prose; a bare i/in before a sentence-final range should not suffice. Preserve the range and preceding words in finanskrisen i 2007-08, and add a regression case alongside a genuine studieåret 2007-08 removal case.

findings.evidence: * Emnets tittel ble endret i juni 2019. Tittel gjeldende frem til endring var Global sikkerhet.
findings.description: The month and year of an administrative course-title revision survive in the anonymized plan. juni 2019 dates a change to the course record, not historical subject matter or a publication. This random control has no pre-pass flag, demonstrating a blind spot in administrative-date detection.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: ONH has no institution-specific handler. The generic administrative-year rule expects a year immediately after a limited keyword set, while other month-year rules cover specific approval or revision-stamp layouts. The prose form Emnets tittel ble endret i juni 2019 is not covered.
findings.suggested_fix: Extend .anon_generic() with a bounded administrative revision pattern for Emnets tittel ble endret i followed by a month and year. Remove the date with its preceding i while retaining the title-history text, and add this sentence as a regression case without broadening removal to historical month-year references.
